items.label: Realistic
items.text: Consequences in the story are Realistic: injury, damage, and loss do not reverse. Wounds heal at realistic rates or not at all, broken things stay broken unless repaired, and the dead stay dead.

items.label: Persistent
items.text: Consequences in the story are Persistent: damage carries forward but does not accumulate. Injuries heal faster than realistically, property is repaired between arcs somehow, and characters recover, but nothing resets within a scene.

items.label: Soft
items.text:
Consequences in the story are Soft: damage matters while a scene is running and fades between them. Characters arrive at the next scene functional. Destruction goes unremarked or repaired once the scene ends.
Do not reference wounds from the previous scene.

items.label: Reset
items.text:
Consequences in the story are Reset: damage and injuries matters while a scene is running and fades between them. Characters arrive at the next scene completely healed. Destruction is completely repaired next scene.
Do not reference injuries or wounds from previous scene.
